Bass Babes Recruitment Event

October 15, 2022Huntington Beach, CaliforniaHistorical Event Archive

Event Story

The documented chapter.

The Bass Babes Recruitment Event in Huntington Beach on October 15, 2022 is the earliest dated event currently preserved in this archive. It establishes the starting point for the timeline before the Wild Ones and Bass Babes names began appearing together in the later 2022 events.

This page is designed as a living historical record. Original photos, flyer artwork, confirmed DJs or artists, and surviving memorabilia can be added without changing the page structure, allowing the record to become richer as source material is recovered.
